purpose: Calibrate the fallback similarity threshold (tau) empirically. Deliberately DISJOINT from data/eval_dataset.json: tuning tau against the frozen eval set would contaminate every metric computed on it. Run scripts/calibrate_threshold.py to score these probes and pick an operating point.
operating_point: Choose the largest tau whose false-refusal rate on in_corpus probes stays at or below 5 percent. Raw bi-encoder cosine is a weak abstention signal - relevant and merely-topical pairs overlap heavily around 0.25-0.45 - so tau is a cheap pre-filter and the model's own prompted abstention is the primary correctness mechanism, not the reverse.
